snippet.title: PSX Longplay [304] TRL: The Rail Loaders
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

This is a nice and original shooter, unfortunately it's too short. You can play either as 1 or 2 players, if you play as one, the second player is still here and he's invincible, which helps a lot as he is not the smartest around. Player 1 is the one that starts on the left side. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
